chapter: Instruments, own band and the Eureka
title: Teaching himself trumpet and playing music, not by ear
summary: He never took a trumpet lesson, learned from a method book after work, and says bands should play reading music rather than by head.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
